caption: Today, on the task you opened mid-sentence: nothing says you were talking, and what you said is gone.
A, listening, on the task you opened: a pill just above the task's own composer, still addressed to the coordinator, with the last words.
A, a long one, opened into its card: the words follow the newest, with pause, stop, back to the conversation, throw away and Send.
A, written and waiting, on the board: the card opens by itself with the text to change, and Send to the coordinator.
A, written, on a task: Send's menu offers this task's lead instead.
B, listening, on the home: a bar along the bottom, as a call has, taking its own room; the latest words run along it.
B, a long one, opened over the task: the whole of it, following the newest words.
B, writing it down while the Mac is busy (the CPU meter at the top is full): it says it will take longer.
B, couldn't write it down: what was said is kept, with Try again and Throw it away.
C, listening, on the task: the same composer, small, in the corner above the task's own, words arriving in its field.
C, written, with who it goes to in its lower row: the coordinator, where you started, or this task's lead.
C, couldn't write it down: the composer's own tray, as the conversation's composer shows it.
D, listening, on the task: only the project's tab says so, with your voice and the time.
D, the words open from the tab, over the top of the screen.
D, written: the tab turns violet, as what waits on you does, and says To send.
E, listening: the words moved into the task's composer and go to its lead, with a line to send them to the coordinator instead.
E, then on the board, which has no composer: a pill, still going to the task you looked at last.
Moved on again, A: from the first task to the board to another; the card still goes to the coordinator, and says what you looked at.
Back at the conversation, in any idea: the overlay goes, and the words are in its own composer, live.
